name: grid-pattern
title: Grid Pattern
description: A background grid pattern made with SVGs, fully customizable using Tailwind CSS.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the SVG. Lines use `stroke-*`, filled squares use `fill-*`.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of one grid cell in pixels.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of one grid cell in pixels.

props.name: x
props.description: Horizontal offset of the pattern in pixels.

props.name: y
props.description: Vertical offset of the pattern in pixels.

props.name: strokeDasharray
props.description: SVG stroke-dasharray of the grid lines, e.g. "4 2" for dashes.
